title: quelques améliorations nécessaires
body:
J’utilise cette application pour suivre mes apports en eau quotidiens et je suis globalement satisfait de son fonctionnement aussi bien sur iPhone que sur Apple Watch. L’interface est claire et l’application est facile à utiliser, ce qui facilite grandement le suivi quotidien.

Cependant, j’aimerais suggérer une amélioration : il serait très utile de pouvoir ajuster les apports en eau pour les activités physiques. Par exemple, après une séance de sport intense, je pourrais avoir besoin de déduire un litre d’eau perdu en transpiration. Actuellement, l’application ne permet pas d’entrer des valeurs négatives pour ajuster ces pertes d’eau. L’ajout de cette fonctionnalité rendrait l’application encore plus adaptée aux besoins des utilisateurs actifs.

En résumé, c’est une excellente application avec un potentiel d’amélioration qui la rendrait parfaite pour tous ceux qui cherchent à mieux gérer leur hydratation au quotidien.

title: Helpful but Needs Refinement
body:
I've integrated HabitMinder into my daily routine and found it incredibly beneficial, serving as a pillar of support in my pursuit of self-improvement. The application stands out due to its structured approach to fostering healthy habits and offers a plethora of tools to aid users on their journey of personal development.

However, there is room for enhancement, particularly in the summary section. Currently, it lacks intuitive design, complicating the process of quickly assimilating and interpreting consolidated progress data. A more coherent and user-friendly summary would substantially elevate the user experience, providing clearer insights into progress and areas requiring focus.

While I don’t have specific recommendations, I have confidence in the inventive team behind HabitMinder to devise solutions that will improve this aspect of the app. Refinements in this area would undoubtedly lead to increased user satisfaction and elevate the app’s overall efficacy.

I am optimistic about the future developments of HabitMinder and believe that with some refinements, it has the potential to become an indispensable companion for those endeavoring to build and maintain positive life habits.

title: Superbe appli, mais statistiques buguée
body:

Peut-être un petit peu trop de notifications en ce qui concerne les verres d’eau (pourquoi pas activer ou désactiver les notifications pour certaines habitudes plus ou moins importantes ?)

Le seul soucis est que le panel de statistiques ne fonctionne pas du tout.
J’ai beau valider certaines de mes habitudes, cela ne s’ajoute pas dans les stats. Dommage!

Je recommande néanmoins si votre seul but est de lister vos habitudes!

title: Would be great if it worked.
body:
Used it for two weeks, cleared all my tasks almost every day to then realise almost none of the days were cleared.
When I look back to each day individually, those fully cleared don't appear as such in the calendar and stats views...

Another weird thing is the meditation timer the runs for 11mn and then logs in 22mn46s........

It's a manual tally app... and it doesn't even do that right...

Don't waste your money.

Edit : the developer's reply is the most corporate and useless reply you'll get it seems... 
I confirm : do not waste your money.

title: It’s a Good one
body:
I was using another app called Productive which has good features but was too expensive 35€/year.
Then I switch to this one and what a great surprise, the fact that we can control and update habits right from the widget is a plus!
Few improvements maybe:
For the “Run” habits goal we only get miles or Km, it’ll be cool to also have “minutes”. For exemple we could set a goal of 20 minutes run.
